source.title: Cannabidiol in Anxiety and Sleep: A Large Case Series

extraction_limitations: The source is a retrospective, uncontrolled, open-label case series; atoms preserve reported observations and do not imply causality.
Later follow-up denominators are reported for the overall cohort, but Table 1 does not report group-specific denominators at months 2 and 3; those atoms do not invent subgroup sample sizes.
Adverse events were collected through spontaneous self-report, so absence of a reported event is not evidence of systematic absence.
The article reports descriptive statistics without inferential estimates, confidence intervals, or a control group for the main anxiety and sleep outcomes.
Background claims and cited-study results in the introduction and discussion were not atomized as primary evidence from this publication.
schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated field for standard deviation; Table 1 SD values are preserved in quantitative_result.original_result_text.
The model has no dedicated field for study-level attrition by visit, so retention is represented as population_description.
governing_source_note: literature(1).py was used for structural validation, literature_atoms(1).py for sufficiency validation, and literature_atom.schema.json for serialization validation. README(2).md informed workflow intent; example_atom(1).json was illustrative only.
